summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Strategy Shares Day Hagan Smart Sector International ETF (SSXU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed equity fund-of-funds that aims to outperform its benchmark by over and underweighting geographic regions outside of the US. SSXU was launched on Jul 1, 2022 and is issued by Day Hagan.

holdings.infoBox: SSXU is an equity ETF with a total of 17 individual holdings. The top holdings are iShares MSCI China ETF stock at 17.83%, Franklin FTSE Japan ETF at 13.84%, iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF at 10.84%, Franklin FTSE United Kingdom ETF at 10.22%, and iShares MSCI South Korea ETF at 9.39%.
